_definition: Ítem → templates Combined (como goal_icons: goals[] = nombres). id = reino/source/nº; order = 1..N plano (= zonas); n_goals antes de goals[]. Matching estricto moons[]/lista[]. Sin totales/All multi-reino ni Capture X. Si hay goal concreta, se quita el paraguas (Nature←Fauna/Flora; Ground Pound/Outfit Door globales; Sand Moons←Oasis/Ruins/…). * Story Moons solo en lunas del grupo story_moon (Cascade #1 → Total Story Moons). Lunas outfit_door: sin goals Sub-Area (solo outfit + resto). n_items_by_n_goals[k] = ítems con exactamente k goals (Σ = n_items). Moon remap mushroom#39 → luncheon#50. Detalle → goals_referencia. No editar.
_note: Regenerar: python Files/export_items_goals.py (o regenerate_all.py). n_items_by_n_goals como goal_icons.n_icons_by_n_goals.
